searchText: No. From the sound of it, we are likely to punt on getting validation synchronized between clients before release, which makes me sad. We are waiting on Nethermind to review their current validation to make the final call, but I'm not optimistic. If thats the case, and the method is already being renamed to `eth_simulateV1` maybe this would be a good time to break it up into two different RPCs (e.g. something like `eth_callManyV2` which focuses on the non-validating path and `eth_simulateV1` which always validates)? The main argument against `call` is that this lets you simulate more than just "contract calls". It lets you simulate blocks and (in theory) any different type of transaction (like blob transactions, withdraws, etc.)
